about: Predictions of the Flame in Freefall team models trained on NASA PSI FLEX droplet data (PSI-69). Not measurements.
encoding: flat integer list, row-major over fuel, mix, o2, p_mmHg, d0; 6 values per point: ext_diameter_mm*100, p_disruption*1000, burning_rate_mm2_s*1000, in_tested_ranges (0/1), similar_runs (tight), nearby_runs (wide); -1 values mark an impossible mix

ext_diameter.name: CatBoost v2 (physics features, rises with droplet size)
